create_video_lmdb_database: create an lmdb database of videos from a list file for Caffe2 VideoInputOp loading
run_create_video_lmdb_cli: run the CLI tool to build a video lmdb dataset from a list file and output directory
create_video_lmdb_test_multicrop: create a multi-crop video lmdb with 3 spatial crops and 10 start frames per video
create_video_lmdb_storing_paths: create a video lmdb that stores file paths instead of raw video data internally
create_video_lmdb_with_labels: create a video lmdb database with integer labels and tensor proto entries for each clip
